description: The field-validation freeze list: what the v1.1 on-wall validation measures (wake cadence, battery telemetry, poll-state fields and the served image hash). A deploy must not change any of it. Values were recorded by running the current byos server, the poll cycle and the policy module, and test_phase47_freeze.py compares running code with this file. Change an entry only with the owner's agreement.

display_response_keys.measured_by: Every wake reads these keys; the image hash decides whether the panel refreshes and sleep_s sets the cadence the validation times.

display_response_values.measured_by: The image hash is how the validation tells a refreshed panel from an unchanged one; reset and firmware must stay inert on a healthy frame.

telemetry_request_headers.measured_by: Battery drain and firmware behaviour in the field validation are read from these request headers; nothing else a frame sends is parsed.

battery_state_keys.measured_by: Battery-life data (the discharge curve the validation records) comes from battery_state.json.

poll_state_keys.measured_by: The validation reads what the poll cycle remembers (detected flight, hold, battery latches) from poll_state.json after a flight was detected.

wake_constants.measured_by: The wake cadence the validation times: the wake bounds and the flat pins that override a saved interval.

sleep_scenarios.measured_by: The sleep_s a frame receives in each mode is the wake cadence the validation measures against battery drain.
